body.en: A sequence of statements evaluated by a Python implementation. Statements may bind names, compute values, control execution, define reusable behavior, or interact with the outside world.
body.vi: A sequence of statements evaluated by a Python implementation. Statements may bind names, compute values, control execution, define reusable behavior, or interact with the outside world.

body.en: Read a program from top to bottom while tracking the current bindings and control flow. When a function is called, create a new local scope; when an exception is raised, follow the active handling path. This model is more durable than memorizing punctuation.
